add.k: A broke man who gets a Chitauri gun working

Sitwell catches him at a motel and, learning he fixed the gun, hires him for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s R&D think tank to reverse-engineer alien tech.

When Sitwell catches them at a motel she fires the gun to save Bennie. Sitwell makes her Agent Blake's new assistant.

In episode 5, after Pilgrim fails to catch Amy, Anderson and his wife Eliza send him to New York to finish the job.
In episode 9, Anderson orders Pilgrim to put a bounty on Frank and Amy, then plays golf with his son, Senator David Schultz.
In episode 13, Frank shoots Eliza dead in front of him, then leaves him a gun and the choice to live with the truth. Anderson shoots himself.

add.k: Anderson's wife, a devout patron of Pilgrim's church
st: In episode 3, Eliza and her husband Anderson, patrons of John Pilgrim's church, promise to care for his family while he is away on their mission.
In episode 5, Eliza visits Pilgrim's sick wife, and she and Anderson send Pilgrim to New York after Amy.
In episode 11, Eliza goes to New York to tell Pilgrim his wife has died and pushes him to finish the mission as a test of faith.
In episode 13, Eliza reaches for a knife to attack Amy at the Schultzes' mansion, and Frank shoots her dead.
